nodes.name: Design Tokens & System Spec
nodes.prompt_template: Define modern CSS design tokens, HSL color palette, typography hierarchy, and glassmorphism utilities.

verification_gate.verifier_prompt: Verify index.css or tokens file exists with HSL color variables and typography rules.

nodes.name: Responsive Component Construction
nodes.prompt_template: Build semantic HTML components with responsive CSS layouts, hover states, and smooth transitions.

verification_gate.verifier_prompt: Validate HTML structure and responsive media queries.

nodes.name: Chrome DevTools Visual Inspection
nodes.prompt_template: Use Chrome DevTools MCP (new_page, take_screenshot) to physically render UI and capture WebP visual evidence.

verification_gate.verifier_prompt: Verify screenshots captured and visual rendering aligned.

nodes.name: A11y Accessibility & Contrast Sweep
nodes.prompt_template: Run accessibility auditing (WCAG AA contrast, ARIA labels, focus states, tap targets).

verification_gate.verifier_prompt: Verify zero high-severity WCAG AA contrast or ARIA violations.
